fusions.name: Dredge Hook
fusions.desc: Hooks a target at or below 25% health from up to 5 tiles, dealing 20 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full range. It uses up every affliction of yours on the target, and each adds 60% more damage.

fusions.name: Bank Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes your tail through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage and knocking enemies 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Carrion Eye
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
